title: Recursive pass — Hsiao Data Policy attribution depth 7
summary: Depth 7 preserves the verified council relationship, rejects unsupported individual authorship, and turns the remaining PDF/roster gap into a reproducible artifact-recovery target backed by a new scraper.

data.research_question: Can specific Data Policy outputs be directly attributed to Katherine Hsiao at depth 7?
data.method: Primary-source WEF HTML review and direct artifact retrieval attempt.
classification_rules: Launch speaker status is not equivalent to paper authorship.
Absence from an HTML speaker list is not proof of non-contribution.
Failed artifact retrieval remains an explicit gap.

findings.finding: Hsiao's council service is directly source-verified, but exact term dates remain absent from the current profile.
Current WEF HTML does not directly credit Hsiao on Pathways to Digital Justice; the official PDF remains necessary for contributor-level resolution.
A reusable WEF artifact collector now exists to recover/hash the official PDF outside the canonical db write path.
